title: Square-zero affine base-change tests detect module tensor exactness
statement: Let S be an affine scheme [def-pc-scheme], C a cochain complex of quasi-coherent O_S-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules] [pqf-def-coherent], and a an integer. Put A = Gamma(S,O_S) and let P be the complex obtained by applying the global-sections evaluation functor termwise. If H^a(g*C) is zero for every scheme map g:S′ -> S [def-pc-base-change], then for every A-module N the ordinary module tensor complex P tensor_A N is exact in degree a. No flatness, boundedness or finite-presentation hypothesis is assumed.

source.place: Tag 01IB (affine equivalence), Tag 01I9 (affine pullback); steps 1--2 of lem-pc-affine-universally-exact-opcycles-flat, square-zero test.

proof.text: The affine equivalence identifies C with the sheafification of P. Kernels and cokernels of quasi-coherent sheaves are quasi-coherent; hence this equivalence computes homology of these complexes as module homology.

For a fixed A-module N use the explicit trivial square-zero A-algebra B=A direct-sum N: (a,x)(b,y)=(ab,ay+bx), with unit (1,0) and the inclusion of A. The spectrum of its inclusion maps to S through the canonical affine isomorphism. The natural affine pullback comparison identifies the global-sections complex of g*C with B tensor_A P. Compatibility with every differential follows from naturality. The homology of this complex is zero by the hypothesis and the preceding affine equivalence.

As A-modules N is a retract of B, via x -> (0,x) and (a,x) -> x. Tensor these two A-linear maps with P in every degree, and commute factors to use right tensoring. They are complex maps and their composite is the identity. Applying homology gives a retraction of H^a(P tensor N) from the zero module. Therefore this homology is zero, equivalently the tensor complex is ExactAt a. The splitting uses only additive A-linearity; the projection to N need not be a ring map.

lean.statement:
theorem affine_universal_tensor_exact (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : IsAffine S)
    (C : CochainComplex S.Modules ℤ) (a : ℤ)
    (hqc : ∀ n : ℤ, (C.X n).IsQuasicoherent)
    (hexact : ∀ {S' : Scheme.{u}} (g : S' ⟶ S),
      IsZero ((((Modules.pullback g).mapHomologicalComplex _).obj C).homology a))
    (N : ModuleCat.{u} Γ(S, ⊤)) :
    (((tensorRight N).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
      (((SheafOfModules.evaluation (R := S.ringCatSheaf) (.op ⊤) :
        S.Modules ⥤ ModuleCat.{u} Γ(S, ⊤)).mapHomologicalComplex
        (.up ℤ)).obj C)).ExactAt a
